q: Should a small company set an internal carbon price?
title: Internal carbon price for a small company
short: It helps if you face carbon costs soon, for example EU buyers paying CBAM or a CCTS target. Use a shadow price per tonne in investment decisions, near the cost you expect to face. Many companies use the CBAM certificate price as a reference. CDP also asks whether you use one.

ol: Pick a price per tonne and a date to review it.
Add price × tonnes saved to each project's savings.
Compare projects on cost with and without the carbon value.

p: A shadow price changes decisions without moving money. An internal fee charges departments and funds projects; it is harder to run in a small firm.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: European Commission, price of CBAM certificates
